tables.title: Table 4. Budget, South Korean Interim Government, Fiscal Year 1947/48
tables.period: Fiscal Year 1947/48; supplemental and total as of 29 February 1948
footnotes: a/ Approved 89,500,000 won for flood damage; 40,667,733 won for increase in wages; 255,000,000 won for nationalization of ships.
b/ Approved 150 million won for Coast Guards; 849,883,140 won for Constabulary.
c/ Approved 1,132,500 won for printing; 1,581,400 won for Taegu Normal College; 13,579,080 won for Teachers Training; 200,000,000 won for Elementary Schools.
d/ Approved 75,000,000 won for refugee housing; 4,000,000 won for Korean Red Cross.
e/ Approved for moving office.
f/ Approved for grain inspectors.
g/ Approved 18 million won for bridge construction; 1,879,100 won for reproduction of maps; 105,890,000 won for flood control.
h/ Approved for the development of coal industry.
i/ Approved for billet guard.
j/ Approved for Inchon prison.

k/ Approved 487,860 won for collection of Bank of Chosun notes from refugees; 2,689,553 won for Accounts Bureau; 40,438,100 won for Treasury Bureau and 120,000,000 won for bonus to Civil Service employees.
l/ Approved for purchase of paper.
m/ Approved for purchase of tobacco.

n/ Approved 14,070,460 won for census; 4,215,800 won for Capitol heating; 200,000 won for State affairs; 3,441,845 won for official gazette; 25,000,000 won for National election, and 2,880,000 won power plant.
o/ Approved for refugees from China and North Korea.
p/ Approved for housing materials.
q/ Approved for building maintenance.
r/ Approved for summer-grain collections.
s/ Approved for 39 additional employees.
t/ Approved for motor pool.
